title: Poem of Thanks: Reversed Six of Swords
pieces: Poem of Thanks: Reversed Six of Swords
notes: DB venue was Afternoon Visitor; published at Noir Sauna (had to pull Afternoon Visitor). pubDate from Squarespace item.publishOn; cover from user-supplied IG post DV58KtZDX25.

research.excerpt: with one face I am prepared / for anything / light finds me / on my own terms / the way I want to be found / a trumpet blows / I rise from the dead / my bones coming together
